name: HumanName
description: Base StructureDefinition for HumanName Type: A human's name with the ability to identify parts and usage.

use.short: usual | official | temp | nickname | anonymous | old | maiden
use.isModifierReason: This is labeled as "Is Modifier" because applications should not mistake a temporary or old name etc.for a current/permanent one

text.short: Text representation of the full name

given.short: Given names (not always 'first'). Includes middle names
given.orderMeaning: Given Names appear in the correct order for presenting the name

prefix.short: Parts that come before the name
prefix.orderMeaning: Prefixes appear in the correct order for presenting the name

suffix.short: Parts that come after the name
suffix.orderMeaning: Suffixes appear in the correct order for presenting the name

period.short: Time period when name was/is in use
